Field Sales Officer (Delivery Bikes) Job at TeamAce Limited




        
    

        
        TeamAce Limited - Our client, a reputable organization in the climate-technology sector, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Field Sales Officer (Delivery Bikes)

Job Location: Maryland, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	As the Field Sales Officer, you will drive the sales of delivery bikes through the company’s Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) model while achieving assigned monthly sales targets.


Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Identify and engage prospective customers interested in acquiring delivery bikes through the BNPL model.
	Conduct field sales activities, product presentations, and follow-ups to convert prospects into customers.
	Build and maintain relationships with customers while providing relevant information on the bike financing process.
	Achieve a monthly sales target and maintain accurate records of sales activities and customer interactions.
	Collaborate with relevant teams to ensure smooth documentation, processing, and delivery of bikes to customers.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree or HND in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Economics, or a related field.
	Minimum of 1–2 years of experience in field sales, preferably in motorcycles, automobiles, mobility solutions, financial services, or related industries.
	Proven ability to meet sales targets with strong prospecting, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills.
	Strong communication, presentation, and persuasion skills with the ability to engage customers in the field.
	Must be target-driven, proactive, and comfortable with extensive field sales activities.


Remuneration
Salary: N150,000 - N200,000 Net Monthly + Commission.

HR Assistant Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited is a human resources solutions company dedicated to helping businesses build stronger teams and manage people functions more effectively. Established in Nigeria in 2013, we have supported organizations for years with high-quality, practical HR services designed to meet real business needs; adapting to evolving workforce demands and enabling long-term growth. With a strong presence in Lagos and Ibadan, and an expanding footprint through Ascentforce in India, we deliver a broader, more connected approach to recruitment, outsourcing, training, and ongoing HR support. Ascentech brings expertise across borders, backed by over 13 years of dedicated experience in delivering practical HR and recruitment solutions.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: HR Assistant

Job Location: Ikoyi, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized HR Assistant to support the effective administration of employee records, documentation, onboarding, and general HR processes.
	The ideal candidate should have strong administrative skills, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain accurate and confidential employee information.


Key Responsibilities


	Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee personnel files, both physical and electronic.
	Prepare employment letters, confirmation letters, warning letters, memos, queries, and other HR correspondence.
	Maintain and update the staff database, including employee details, positions, departments, resumption dates, and employment status.
	Ensure all HR documents are properly filed and easily accessible.
	Monitor staff documentation and follow up on outstanding employee records.
	Assist with the onboarding of newly employed staff.
	Ensure new employees complete all required HR documentation before or upon resumption.
	Coordinate staff orientation and introduction to company policies and procedures.
	Assist with issuing staff ID cards, uniforms, and other company property where applicable.
	Maintain records of employee probation periods and notify the HR Manager when employees are due for confirmation or performance review.
	Provide general administrative support to the HR team as required.
	Maintain confidentiality of employee information and HR records at all times.


Requirements


	B.Sc./HND in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, or a related field.
	1–3 years of relevant HR/Admin experience.
	Good knowledge of HR documentation and personnel administration.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel.
	Strong organizational and record-keeping skills.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	High level of confidentiality, accuracy, and attention to detail.
	Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.


Salary
N200,000 monthly.

Compensation& Benefits

Method of Application 
Interesated and qualified candidate should forward their CV to: [email protected] usingthe Job Position as the subject of the email.

	Minimum of 5 years of experience in accounting.
	Must be from a top university.
	Must possess supervisory or managerial experience.
	Good English communication skills, both written and verbal.
	Hands-on experience with accounting software.
	Advanced MS Excel skills.
	Experience with general ledger functions.
	Strong attention to detail and good analytical skills.
	Additional certification is a plus.
